test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In January 2024, what significant milestone did the Indian Air Force (IAF) achieve in terms of landing operations?

options.text: First deployment of the Garud Special Forces using a C-130J Super Hercules
First operation of a C-130J Super Hercules at the world's highest airstrip
First successful night landing at the Kargil airfield with a C-130J Super Hercules
First landing of a C-130J Super Hercules aircraft at Daulat Beg Oldie

solution:
The correct answer is __**First successful night landing at the Kargil airfield with a C-130J Super Hercules**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In January 2024, the Indian Air Force achieved a significant milestone by conducting the **first successful night landing** at the Kargil airfield using a **C-130J Super Hercules**.
 
• This operation demonstrated the IAF's enhanced **night-time operational capabilities** in high-altitude and tough terrains.
 
• The C-130J Super Hercules is known for its versatility, capable of landing on **short and unpaved airstrips**, making it ideal for such challenging missions.
 
• This achievement marks a strategic enhancement, ensuring better **logistical and tactical support** in the region, especially in times of conflict or emergency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **C-130J Super Hercules**:

 
 
• A military transport aircraft known for its **versatility and reliability**.
 
• Capable of performing a variety of missions, including **transport, medevac, and aerial refueling**.
 
• Equipped with advanced avionics and propulsion systems to handle **short and unpaved runways**.
 
 
 
• **Kargil Airfield**:
 
 
• Located in the challenging terrain of the **Himalayan region**.
 
• Strategically important due to its proximity to the **Line of Control (LoC)**.
 
• Used primarily for transport and logistical purposes during the **Kargil War** in 1999.
 
 
 
• **Night Operations**:
 
 
• Require advanced **navigation and landing systems**.
 
• Enhance the **operational readiness** of the air force.
 
• Critical for **surprise and stealth** missions.
 
 
 
• **Indian Air Force (IAF)**:
 
 
• The air arm of the **Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• Responsible for securing Indian airspace and conducting aerial warfare.
 
• Continuously upgrading its fleet and capabilities to handle modern-day threats and challenges.
